messages:
olga: dropping a compact mock for the min/max + burst controls. goal: one-line pool row with an inline min/max stepper and a small burst affordance. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abcd1234/compact-capacity (bottom-right frames) kevin: quick skim — nice density. the burst chip feels heavy next to the steppers, maybe make it icon-only with a subtle border? :thinking_face: anita: microcopy: change 'Burst capacity' → 'Short-term burst' (helps set expectation). also keyboard flow: tab lands on burst before max which feels weird — should be min → max → burst tooltip. sarah: accessibility nits: burst control missing aria-label, and the stepper value changes need an aria-live region so screenreaders announce increments. contrast on the mini stepper borders is 3.8:1 — needs to be 4.5:1 for smaller text. devon: routing/ops note — when you switch GPU pool, we should surface an immediate estimated cost/QPS delta inline (tiny text under steppers). otherwise PMs always ask where the cost moved. also consider showing predicted latency change for pinned SLO. maria: +1 on the copy tweak. Also suggest a tooltip for burst that shows: "Duration, estimated tokens/min, and cost per min" so folks don't click blindly. tiny ask: can the burst toggle remember last-used quanta per pool? olga: noted — will iterate. quick aria example I'm planning to add: ```html
Min set to 2, Max set to 8
``` kevin: guardrail copy also feels alarmist: current draft "We may scale below your min during outages" -> I'd suggest "Autoscaling may temporarily reduce capacity during escalations" (less blame-y). anita: can we add a small QA checklist in the ticket? tab order, screenreader readouts, contrast, tooltip focusable, tooltip content length. put it in the PR template so designers don't forget accessibility checks. olga: love the checklist idea — I'll add checklist items and push v2 by EOD. leaving a small visual suggestion: reduce burst color saturation and add a thin dividing line between steppers and burst so the row breathes. :thumbsup:
